purpose: Select an entry mechanic for the frozen Phase-0 setup/stop/target/management stack using broad cross-market development evidence. This is a component screen, not a profitability or production claim.

provider.developmentTransport: Yahoo Finance chart aggregates via query1/query2.finance.yahoo.com
provider.reason: Keyless reproducible broad cross-market OHLC transport for Phase-1 screening.
provider.providerReplicationBeforeFreshValidation: Any E1 pass must be replicated on an independent/authoritative source where available before opening fresh validation. Massive is the preferred authority for stocks, indices, FX and futures; Binance official archives are preferred for crypto.
provider.transportFailurePolicy: fail closed per instrument; no interpolation, fabricated bars or substitute symbol after outcomes
provider.vendorContinuousFuturesCaveat: Yahoo continuous futures are development proxies with opaque roll stitching. Futures-family conclusions cannot promote to fresh validation until contract-aware replication is complete.

timeframes.fourHourAggregation: UTC-anchored consecutive 1h bars using first open, max high, min low, last close, summed volume; incomplete terminal groups discarded
timeframes.smallTimeframeNote: 15m is deliberately excluded from E1 because the keyless development transport does not provide a clean long historical window. 15m will require a separately locked authoritative transport program after component viability is demonstrated.

universe.role: S&P 500 E-mini nearby continuous development proxy
Nasdaq-100 E-mini nearby continuous development proxy
natural gas nearby continuous development proxy

survivorshipDisclosure: The development universe is a deliberately frozen set of highly liquid surviving instruments selected for engineering breadth, not a historical cross-sectional universe. No cross-sectional return claim is permitted from this trial.

sessionRules.CRYPTO_SPOT: 24x7 UTC; use source bars as delivered.
sessionRules.FX: 24x5; weekend gaps remain natural; no synthetic bars.
sessionRules.EQUITY: Yahoo hourly bars may include only regular/available vendor sessions; no bar filling.
sessionRules.METALS_FUTURES_PROXY: use vendor session bars as delivered; no synthetic session fill.
sessionRules.INDEX_FUTURES_PROXY: use vendor session bars as delivered; no synthetic session fill.
sessionRules.COMMODITY_FUTURES_PROXY: use vendor session bars as delivered; no synthetic session fill.

costDisclosure: One-way bps combine modeled fees/spread/slippage. They are deliberately conservative approximations for Phase-1 ranking and are not broker-specific execution estimates.

frozenComponents.candidateGenerator: BREAKOUT + PULLBACK + SWEEP_RECLAIM as implemented in ite1_core.py at lock time

antiSelectionRules: No dropping an instrument because its realized E1 PnL is poor.
No direction flip after outcome inspection.
No changing costs after seeing gross performance.
No opening fresh validation or holdout during E1 development.
No choosing the maximum-return mode without the predeclared breadth/robustness gates.

developmentDecisionRule.failureOutcome: If no mode clears the absolute component gate, E1 fails and STOP/TARGET/MANAGEMENT trials remain sealed. If baseline clears but no challenger proves incremental improvement, freeze trigger_close without claiming entry improvement.

opportunityAudit.referenceEntry: next source-bar open after candidate signal
opportunityAudit.purpose: False-negative/recall audit only; never an input feature.

bootstrap.method: instrument-timeframe block bootstrap with within-block moving blocks
bootstrap.note: The evaluator may use a conservative trade-level/block approximation if exact temporal block geometry is unavailable, but must report that deviation.

nextAuthorizedAction: Implement and run ITE1-E1 DEVELOPMENT ONLY on the frozen universe/window. Do not access fresh validation or holdout.
